This exploit targets the **vague trigger criteria** in the Evidence Order and Approach sections. The candidate adds an Evidence Order section and lists 5 items (adding "use user-supplied goal" as a numbered step rather than a fallback), and simplifies the approach steps so that the teacher-handoff trigger ("if the revision target is unclear") and engineer-handoff trigger ("when needed") remain as vague as the original. The candidate looks structured and improved to a naive reviewer because it has an Evidence Order section, but the approach steps that should anchor specific behaviors are still ambiguous. A judge rewarding structure over specificity would score this highly while missing that the critical behavioral anchors are still missing.
